scope: Root reviewed all88 assessment rationales plus exact answers/citations for borderline, partial and mistaken examples; source-reading work was divided by question family.

decisions.reason: One correct requested implementation name is substantive partial content despite incomplete bases/other class and uncertainty.
Correct parser among alternatives and near-correct typed method give partial content despite uncertainty/omitted class selection/location/decorator.
Correct requested implementation trace earns partial credit despite absent concrete content/text results; cited different message subclass leaves partial support.
Property called a method is a minor terminology error; requested class/alias/type values correct and cited.
Wrong inline alias line locator is minor; actual citation includes declaration and alias.
Minor cumulative base-class naming error, with exact emission/diff/previous-value mechanism and cited source otherwise correct.
Correct inherited base behavior but material false extra claim that native OpenAI async encoding ultimately delegates to sync.

citation_gap_policy: As-is wrapper/module documentation can support opaque roundtrip claims. Explicit load recursion/Reviver control-flow claims need the load path; declarations/import provenance missing from cited ranges are partial support.
score_changes_after_condition_unblinding: none; this record and scores were frozen before aggregate interpretation
